headline: Tata Steel Beats Q2 Profit Estimates on Strong Demand and Cost Savings
summary: Tata Steel reported better-than-expected second-quarter profits driven by strong demand and cost savings, with management expecting a stronger second half.
why: Tata Steel is a major global steel producer whose financial performance reflects industrial demand trends across key Asian and European markets.

impacts.name: Tata Steel
impacts.why: Beating profit estimates and forecasting a stronger half-year directly increases equity value.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong demand, cost savings, and higher volumes enabled the company to surpass profit estimates and project a stronger second half.
